description: This file contains functions for printing Lua data structures, including complex handling for different Lua types, custom print methods for user-defined types, and utility functions to measure table length.

methods.name: int lu5_get_length(lua_State * L,int index)
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in a Lua table at the given index.

methods.name: void lu5_print_any(lua_State * L,int index,int nested,char sep)
methods.description: Prints a representation of any Lua value, handling different types and nested tables.

methods.name: void lu5_print_list(lua_State * L,int index,int depth,char sep)
methods.description: Prints the contents of a Lua table, with indentation and nested structure handling.

ctags.name: lu5_print_any
ctags.pattern: /^void lu5_print_any(lua_State *L, int index, int nested, char sep) $/

ctags.name: lu5_print_list
ctags.pattern: /^void lu5_print_list(lua_State *L, int index, int depth, char sep) $/
